article_content: On the last CNN Student News before the Thanksgiving break, several significant stories were covered. The US Defense Secretary has stepped down, a grand jury in Missouri has delivered its verdict, and a nuclear agreement involving Iran has been delayed. Additionally, the program explored earthquake swarms and provided tips on staying safe online. Teachers should note that the daily show will resume on December 1. A transcript of the current show is available, and viewers can request to be featured on the CNN Student News Roll Call by commenting with their school's name, mascot, city, and state.
